subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: k18_float is green after V17s VMOV fix; k_v15_extend still 5/20 in arm-O2
body: Re-ran run_diff with the current tree (130 kernels): k18_float now matches on all 20 seeds in arm-O2 and thumb-O2, so F12 is confirmed fixed. Remaining arm-O2 mismatches are k18_select (VEXT, V20), k_i8_loop/k_i16_loop/k_i16_mul/k_neon_vmla16/k_neon_vsubl/k_u8_sad (V19 narrow decode + VEXT), and k_v15_extend 5 seeds (expected 84068594 got 8406859c for seed 2; its -marm code uses vmov.u8 rX,dY[lane], so likely the VMOV lane path, not V15 media). arm-O0 is 2600/2600. Full table/log at /tmp/n2hw-T01/diff_now12.log (host side only).
